beats.note: EPSILON CYGNI, 3089 AD. ALL LIFE ON THE EXOPLANET LYRA HAS BEEN OBLITERATED...
...APART FROM THE HOLOSONIC VESSEL QNTM CNTRL...
FOUR-DIMENSIONAL MANIFOLD ENABLED, QNTM CNTRL TRAVERSES THE EXPANSE OF CYGNUS A...
beats.why: Paul, 25 October: the reader drags to fold the manifold's slabs together; when the creases meet the ship slingshots through (to build)

beats.note: OUR FALLEN SHIP IS INTERCEPTED BY A SCOUT PATROL FROM AN ANCIENT TRIBE.
THEIR PLUNDER OF QNTM CTRL'S HOLD RETRIEVES URANIUM AND THE INVALUABLE CRYPTID, STILL DEEP IN HYPERSLEEP.
IN METABOLIC STASIS, THE PSYCHEDELIC VIBRATIONS OF THEIR BONFIRE RITUAL...
beats.why: Paul, 25 October: the reader taps in time with the music; on-beat taps flare the fire and the pod; about eight good hits trigger the decode (to build)

beats.note: ...WOULD SOON TRIGGER OBTRAN TO BEGIN ITS DECODE PROTOCOL.

atmosphere.note: Paul, 25 October: sand was used too often; mist as the alternative, or no effect at all. Mist where the painting has smoke or night air; none in open space, the cockpit and the decode.

helix.note: Paul, 25 October: the twisting DNA strands built precisely in 3D for the final scene. from/to are [yaw, pitch, distance] in the world's frame (Marble units): near the ends of the world's own helix, measured from its mint splats (it arcs round the viewer about 2 units out), lowered about 9 and 5 degrees so the 3D one crosses the middle of the view; the 3D one runs along the chord between them, so it passes a little nearer. radius from the spread of those splats. fadeHue: [hue from, hue to, least brightness, fade] for the world's own helix splats. colours: sampled from the panel's own helix (Paul: the same colour as the original, with the grade): its mid, shadow (15-30% luminance) and light (85-100%) mint, and the panel's darkest ink (luminance under 0.08).

animate.note: Paul, 25 October: the smoke from the wreck animated in code. The world's own pale, unsaturated splats above the wreck rise (rise: share of their distance per cycle), sway and thin out, then start again.
The ship's vapour loop: shimmer with pulses running along it (freq: ripple frequency, speed: how fast the pulses run).
The escaping ship's trail over the ruins.
The manifold's white floor (the page's gutters, which Marble turned into ground under the slabs): cut.
The ship's trail through the folds.
